records.applicability: http-cache-semantics 4.2.0 is in the Admin application graph only through development tooling: @angular/cli 21.2.28 -> pacote 21.5.1 -> make-fetch-happen 15.0.6 (via npm-registry-fetch 19.1.1, sigstore/@sigstore/sign 4.1.1 and tuf-js 4.1.0, all integrity-identical to the 2026-10-07 measurement). It is not in the production bundle. make-fetch-happen/lib/cache/policy.js is its only requirer and builds every CachePolicy with { shared: false, ignoreCargoCult: true }; the advisory's mechanism needs a shared cache. Measured 2026-10-23 on e864c826 (Node 20, offline, preload probe with positive controls): ng version, eslint ., ng build --configuration=production and ng test (842/842) loaded neither http-cache-semantics, make-fetch-happen nor pacote. Package operations (ng add, ng update) were source-traced, not exercised. This does not cover a consumer that constructs a shared cache.
records.reason: As of 2026-10-23 no fixed release exists: the advisory lists no patched version and 4.3.0 is the latest release. 4.3.0 is outside the recorded range but leaves the max-stale and shared Set-Cookie handling byte-identical, so it is not a fix and is not installed. Removing the package means an Angular major (22, Node >=22.22.3), which is not a dependency fix. Without a disposition the measured application graph is blocking. The accepted residual risk is that a traced-but-unexercised tooling consumer behaves differently from the measured runs. Remove this record in the same change that installs a release fixing the mechanism or removes the package; it expires at 00:00 UTC on 2026-12-31 and is not extended automatically.
